title: "New Embeddings — Revision"

# Overview

## Two types of embeddings (Embeddings)

| Type | Base | Models | Relationship captured |
|------|------|---------|-------------------|
| Content | Frequency of terms | TF·IDF, LSI, BIR | Correlations **linear** |
| Context-based | Local co-occurrence | Word2Vec, Glove | Relations **nonlinear** |

A term is characterized by the terms that surround it.

---

# Word2Vec

## Formal Setup

- $W_T$: term **target** (Target Word)
- $W_C$: **context term** (Context Word)
- **Objective**: estimate $\mathbb{P}(W_T \mid W_C)$

## CBoW vs Skip-gram

| | CBoW | Skip-gram |
|-|------|-----------|
| Directorate | Context → Target | Target → Background |
| Target probability | $\mathbb{P}(W_T \mid W_C)$ | $\mathbb{P}(W_C \mid W_T)$ |
| Advantage | Quick, common words | Rare words, small corpus |

## Architecture (CBoW)

```
[w(t-2)]  ─┐
[w(t-1)]  ─┤─→ W (N×C) ─→ Somme ─→ W' (C×N) ─→ Softmax ─→ [w(t)]
[w(t+1)]  ─┤
[w(t+2)]  ─┘
```

- Parameters : $\theta = [W, W']$
- Approximation: $\mathbb{P}(W_T \mid W_C) \sim v_T^{\prime\,\top} v_C$

## Loss Function

$$\mathcal{L}(W_T;\,\theta) = -\sum_{W_C \in \text{context}(W_T)} \log\,\mathbb{P}(W_T \mid W_C)$$

$$\mathcal{L}(\mathcal{X};\,\theta) = \frac{1}{N}\sum_{W_T \in \mathcal{X}} \mathcal{L}(W_T;\,\theta) \quad \Rightarrow \quad \theta^* = \arg\min_\theta\,\mathcal{L}(\mathcal{X};\,\theta)$$

## Softmax

$$\mathbb{P}(W_T \mid W_C) = \frac{\exp(v_T^{\prime\,\top} v_C)}{\sum_i \exp(v_i^{\prime\,\top} v_C)}$$

⚠️ **Coût** : $O(N)$ — prohibitif pour grand vocabulaire.

**Solution** : Softmax hiérarchique (Hierarchical Softmax) → $O(\log N)$ via arbre binaire (ex. WordNet).

**Alternative** : Negative Sampling — comparer la cible correcte à quelques exemples négatifs aléatoires.

---

# GloVe (Global Vectors)

## Motivation

⚠️ Word2Vec ignore la **densité globale** des co-occurrences.

GloVe : les co-occurrences **fréquentes** pèsent davantage.

## Probabilité de co-occurrence

$$\mathbb{P}_{\text{cooc}}(w_k \mid w_i) \propto \frac{\text{card}\{(w_k, w_i)\}}{\text{card}\{(w_i)\}}$$

## Model

$$v_i^\top v_k = \log\,\text{card}\{(w_k, w_i)\} - \underbrace{\log\,\text{card}\{(w_i)\}}_{b_i\text{ (biais)}}$$

### Propriété clé — différence vectorielle

$$\frac{\mathbb{P}_{\text{cooc}}(w_k \mid w_i)}{\mathbb{P}_{\text{cooc}}(w_k \mid w_j)} = \exp\!\left((v_i - v_j)^\top v_k\right)$$

The **translation** $v_i - v_j$ encodes the co-occurrence ratio → vector analogies.

## Glove Loss Function

$$\mathcal{L} = \sum_{w_i, w_k} \underbrace{\psi(\text{card}\{(w_k,w_i)\})}_{\text{pondération}} \left(v_i^\top v_k + b_i + b_k - \log\,\text{card}\{(w_k,w_i)\}\right)^2$$

### Fonction $\psi$ (pondération)

$$\psi(x) = \begin{cases} (x / x_{\max})^\alpha & x < x_{\max} \\ 1 & \text{sinon} \end{cases}$$

- $\psi(0) = 0$: null co-occurrence ignored
- $\psi(\infty) = 1$: co-occurrences very frequent capped
- Typical values: $\alpha = 3/4$, $x_{\max} = 100$

# Overall summary table

| Model | Type | Entity | Similarity |
|--------|------|--------|------------|
| Boolean | Content | Term | Logic operators |
| TF·IDF | Content | Document | Cosinus |
| BIR | Content | Term | Product (i.e.) |
| LSI | Content | Document | Cosinus |
| Word2Vec | Background | Term | **Euclidian distance** |
| Glove | Background | Term | **Euclidian distance** |

---

# Critical points

## Why nonlinear?

- Functions **exp / softmax** in learning → complex geometric relationships (translations, rotations)
- LSI = linear (matrix factorization) → only correlations

## Practical use

1. Recover vector of each term via **correlation table** (lookup table)
2. Document = **average** vectors of its terms
3. Similarity = **Euclidian distance** in embedding space

The similarity measurement **must be consistent** with the embedding model.

## Societal Biais (Societal Biases)

- embeddings inherits the **bias** from the training corpus
- Example: problematic gender associations (Bolukbasi et al., 2016)

## Limits

| Limit | Solution |
|--------|----------|
| Words outside vocabulary (OOV) | **FastText** (subwords / subwords) |
| Polysemia (one vector per word) | **BERT** (embeddings contexts) |
| Societal bias | Debishing techniques |

---

# Dimensionality

- Vocabulary: $N$ words ($10^4$–$10^6$)
- embedding dimension: $C$ (typically 100–300)
- $W$ : $N \times C$ — $W'$ : $C \times N$
- $v_T^{\prime\,\top} v_C$: **scalar**

---

# Modern extensions

- **FastText**: sub-word enriched vectors
- **BERT** : embeddings contexts (Transformers)
- **Dense Retrieval** : Modern IR = search for the ** nearest approximate neighbour** (Approximate Nearest Neighbor)
